view_frame: Front view (XZ) displays the wheel face with X as horizontal width and Z as vertical height. Right view (YZ) displays the wheel thickness with Y as depth and Z as height. The wheel is centered at the origin (0,0,0).

features.placement: Centered at (0,0,0). Outer radius 60 mm, inner radius 50 mm. Extends from Y=-4 mm to Y=4 mm.
features.evidence: Front view shows two concentric circles. Right view shows a rectangular profile of uniform thickness. Text label 'OD 120 mm; thickness 8 mm'.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0,0). Radius 15 mm. Extends from Y=-4 mm to Y=4 mm.
features.evidence: Front view shows a central circle. Right view shows uniform thickness matching the rim.

features.placement: 8 instances arranged radially in the XZ plane. Each spoke extends from the hub surface (r=15) to the rim inner surface (r=50). Extends from Y=-4 mm to Y=4 mm.
features.evidence: Front view shows 8 radial lines connecting the hub to the rim. Right view shows uniform thickness.

connections: The hub is concentric with the rim.
The spokes connect the outer surface of the hub to the inner surface of the rim.
All features share the same Y-axis thickness range (-4 mm to 4 mm).
edit_rules: Changing OD 120 mm updates the rim outer radius and spoke length.
Changing thickness 8 mm updates the Y-axis extent of all features.
Changing ASSUMED hub_diameter updates the hub radius and spoke length.
Changing ASSUMED rim_width updates the rim inner radius and spoke length.
Changing ASSUMED spoke_width updates the width of the spoke boxes.
